name: Itako (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Itako city emblem in white: a disc crossed by a stylised lightning-like stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Itako, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 2002.

features.role: Itako city emblem — a disc crossed by a stylised lightning-like stroke
